title: Digital, guideline-based care for hard-to-heal and/or chronic wounds - Evaluation of a multimodal healthcare approach
summary:
The DigiLeit project aims to improve the care of patients with chronic wounds. This will be achieved by making it easier to integrate medical guideline recommendations into everyday clinical practice through digital solutions. The goal is to provide better support for physicians and nursing staff in diagnosis and treatment.
To this end, software is being developed to help record patients’ symptoms in a structured way. Based on this information, digital pathways for diagnosis and treatment are created, following established medical recommendations.
These digital pathways are integrated into everyday medical practice, and regular evaluations are carried out to ensure that the treatment is achieving the desired goals. In this way, up-to-date medical knowledge is directly applied in clinical practice.
conditions: chronic wounds resulting from diabetes mellitus, chronic venous insufficiency, or peripheral arterial occlusive disease

interventions.name: Intervention group B: Patients are treated within the framework of the new care concept in a specialized wound healing center (WhZ). criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Chronic wounds on the foot and/or lower leg
- Insured with a public health insurance
Exclusion criteria:
- Clinical diagnosis excludes the following underlying conditions: diabetes mellitus, peripheral arterial disease, chronic venous insufficiency
- Ongoing chemotherapy
- Use of immunosuppressive medication
- Requirement for dialysis
- Individuals who refuse a physical examination
- Insufficient knowledge of the German language
